ce_bugs.text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 — URL rewriting turns protocol-relative links such as //cdn.example.com/a into paths on the article host and leaves directory-relative links unresolved, breaking imported links and images.
lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — Replacing PostCreator with import_remote drops the original created_at value, so imported Disqus topics receive today's date while their replies retain historical dates.

db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — Adding `force: true` to this existing migration drops a pre-existing `top_topics` table before recreation, permanently deleting cached topic-ranking data when the migration is rerun or unrecorded.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:13 — import` mutates the caller-owned `contents` string, so reusing it appends duplicate footers and creates spurious revisions.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — The unbounded, timeout-free remote read runs in a Sidekiq job, so a slow or never-ending embedded page can occupy workers and leave discussions stuck loading.
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — The feed is fetched without a timeout or response-size limit, so a stalled or oversized feed can tie up the scheduled worker and stop feed imports.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — Separating SETNX from EXPIRE lets a crash or Redis error leave a permanent throttle key, after which that embed URL is silently skipped forever.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — RSS item HTML reaches raw_html cooking without sanitization, allowing feed-provided scripts and event handlers to execute on the forum origin.

mrv_findings.text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — P1 confidence 100: `if $redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1")` followed by a separate `$redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60)` leaves a permanent throttle key if the worker dies between commands, preventing that article from ever being retrieved by ordinary users.

lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — P1 confidence 100: `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` runs without an exception boundary before `fetch_http`, so an unavailable or malformed feed prevents retrieval of otherwise healthy article pages instead of falling back to direct import.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — P1 confidence 100: `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` executes inside the unprotected item loop, so one item with absent content aborts the batch and prevents every later valid item from importing on every poll.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:37 — P1 confidence 100: `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` commits separately from the post revision without a shared lock, allowing overlapping imports to leave one version's post body with another version's checksum and subsequently skip the update needed to correct stale content.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — P2 confidence 100: `doc = Readability::Document.new(open(url).read,` materializes the entire remote body without a size bound before DOM construction, allowing a large article response to exhaust a shared background worker's memory.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 — P2 confidence 100: `if href.present? && href.start_with?('/')` and `a['href'] = "#{prefix}/#{href.sub(/^\/+/, '')}"` omit document-relative URLs such as `images/photo.jpg` and rewrite protocol-relative URLs such as `//cdn.example/photo.jpg` onto the article host, breaking imported links and images instead of resolving all relative URL forms against the source URL.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — P1 confidence 75: `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` provides no fallback for valid RSS items that carry only a description or Atom entries with only a summary, so absent content raises rather than importing supported feed entries.

app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:16 — P2 confidence 100: `render 'loading'` handles every unknown embed URL identically even when its host is invalid and TopicRetriever will always reject it, leaving the iframe reloading indefinitely instead of reporting the invalid URL.

app/views/embed/best.html.erb:6 — P1 confidence 100: `<%- end if %>` generates invalid Ruby (`end if ;`), so every embed request with an existing topic fails template compilation instead of displaying the discussion.

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — P2 confidence 100: `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` replaces the existing category-aware, historically dated Disqus topic creation while deleting its `--category` option, so an embed URL enhancement unnecessarily removes category selection and resets imported topic dates to import time.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — P1 confidence 100: `creator = PostCreator.new(user, title: title, raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])` stores feed HTML without sanitization and the new `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` bypass preserves script elements and event handlers, allowing a malicious feed entry to execute stored XSS on the forum origin.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — P1 confidence 75: `doc = Readability::Document.new(open(url).read,` follows HTTP redirects after TopicRetriever checks only the original hostname, so an allowed-host redirect to an internal HTTP endpoint bypasses the host restriction and fetches internal content into a public imported post.

lib/topic_retriever.rb:26 — P2 confidence 100: `retrieved_key = "retrieved:#{@embed_url}"` throttles only exact URLs, so an anonymous caller supplying the configured Referer can vary a query parameter to trigger unlimited fetches and full feed polls as the configured import user, exhausting workers and creating duplicate topics.

app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:17 — P3 confidence 100: `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` accepts an attacker origin that is merely a prefix of the forum URL rather than its exact origin and never checks the sender window, allowing an attacker window with a page reference to send resize messages that hide or distort the comments frame.

spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:34 — P2 confidence 100: `topic_retriever.expects(:retrieved_recently?).returns(false)` replaces the new throttle implementation in every allowed-host success test, so broken Redis expiry, repeated retrieval, and staff bypass behavior pass without any real throttle being exercised.

spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:34 — P2 confidence 100: `poller.expects(:poll_feed).once` mocks the entire new feed ingestion path and no example executes it, so parsing, item URL fallback, content extraction, and persisted imports can all fail while this suite passes.

spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:19 — P2 confidence 100: `SiteSetting.stubs(:feed_polling_url).returns(nil)` leaves `feed_polling_enabled?` at its false default, as does the username guard example, so both tests short-circuit before their claimed guards and still pass if those guards are removed.

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:10 — P2 confidence 100: `response.should_not be_success` in the missing-embed-url example accepts any failure while leaving the embeddable host unset, so the before-filter rejects the request before parameter validation and the test cannot establish either the claimed 404 or enforcement of the required parameter.

spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb:41 — P2 confidence 75: `post.cooked.should =~ /new contents/` checks only the returned in-memory object without reloading the original post or asserting unchanged IDs and counts, so failed persistence or duplicate-post creation can satisfy the purported update test.
